text: Rikyū became Nobunaga's tea master in 1579, aged 58.

Ieyasu and Nobunaga were allies for twenty years, from 1562 until Nobunaga's death in 1582.
Ieyasu fought Hideyoshi in 1584, then served him until Hideyoshi's death in 1598, after which he took power.
Hideyoshi rose from a peasant background as Nobunaga's retainer. When Nobunaga was killed in 1582, he avenged him at the Battle of Yamazaki and took his place.
